What I found:
- For refused packages, they are normally treated as a standard return.
- But if any damage occurred to the box or parts during transit or upon delivery, the site says to contact One Fast Cat so they can arrange replacement parts to be sent out.
I also found standard return details such as returned items needing to be shipped back for a refund, with shipping fees and duties noted as nonrefundable and return shipping generally the buyer’s responsibility.
So based on the available information, damage in transit may be handled through replacement parts rather than a normal return in that situation.
